text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- The aim of the government to reorganize Russian secondary schools into Estonian-language schools by the year 2000 is unrealistic, a member of the parliamentary culture commission Paul-Erik Rummo says.
- Russian experts have delivered their recommendations to Estonia on how to improve the situation of the local Russian population, a spokesman of the Russian Foreign Ministry said.
- The government does not support a proposal of the right-wing Pro Patria party to hold a referendum on the Estonian-Russian border agreement.
- The vice-speaker of the Russian Duma Sergei Baburin will arrive for a two-day visit to Tallinn on December 20.
- Historian Indrek Jurjo launched his book "Estonians in exile and Soviet Estonia", based on the material from KGB archives.
- People at Saaremaa and Muhu islands are in support of building a bridge connecting the islands to the mainland.
- The government approved a draft agreement for cooperation with U.S. firm NRG Energy, owned by Northern States Power to prepare the privatisation of power stations.
